description: This file defines the ObserverGrain class implementing observer pattern interfaces, managing a single observer and a target grain, with methods to set target, subscribe observer, and notify state changes.

classes.name: ObserverGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing observer pattern interfaces, managing observer subscriptions and state change notifications.

methods.name: SetTarget
methods.description: Sets the target grain and subscribes this grain as an observer.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to this grain.

methods.name: StateChanged
methods.description: Notifies the observer of a state change with two integer parameters.
